findings.reason: The first implementation treated evidence descriptors as one fixed layer and keyed lookups with a stale three-part locator, causing valid memory/tool inputs to fail. Fixed with a two-layer locator contract and regression coverage.

An empty task_state produced a synthetic selected source observation even though project_context emits no task message. Fixed so empty task state has a zero-count layer summary and no fabricated source.

A caller could recompute projection_sha256 after adding a kept evidence item absent from source, and the explanation would silently ignore it. The observed regression returned complete; fixed to refuse projection_shape_mismatch without echoing the body.
The missing-metadata test recomputed projection_sha256 while the old hash was still inside the hashed manifest, producing a false mismatch. Fixed to hash the manifest without projection_sha256.

The required independent fresh-context review completed and read the full exact diff. It did not return a zero-finding verdict: it found F6. F5 is closed as review coverage completed, while landing remains held for the separate public-action and exact-SHA CI gates.

A digest-bound manifest could place body text in dropped[].reason and the report echoed it verbatim as reason_code. The observed regression returned partial and exposed SECRET_BODY_AS_REASON. Fixed by requiring the closed dropped-sidecar shape and only duplicate_source or over_budget reason codes; the red regression now refuses invalid_projection_shape without echoing the canary.

The F6 closed-reason membership check evaluated unhashable list/object values before validating their type. The observed digest-bound red regression failed in four list/object subtests with TypeError. One string-type guard now returns the existing invalid_projection_shape refusal; seven malformed-value subtests also assert no body echo and unchanged inputs. Independent new-diff review returned no actionable finding.
